summary: State-erected 120-foot steel tower at Maxton, Robeson County, dated 1962-64 in an NC listing; no source read says whether it still stands.

events.note: Listing dates it 1962-64: a new 120-foot steel tower erected by the State on newly acquired land

evidence.supports: new 120-foot steel tower erected by the State, 1962-64, on newly acquired land
evidence.quote: 1962-64: A new 120-foot steel tower was erected by the State on newly acquired land.

evidence.supports: listing filed under North Carolina Forest Service, Robeson County
evidence.quote: Robeson County - North Carolina Forest Service

evidence.supports: listing cites a 1964 state biennial report
evidence.quote: (Department of Conservation and Development - 20th Biennial Report - 1964)

notes_for_editor: Single source: one entry in the Eastern US Lookouts NC page. The entry gives dates, design and agency but nothing on status, staffing or access; web searches found nothing more. The word 'new' suggests a replacement, but no earlier tower is named, so the story does not say so. The 120-foot figure is the tower size in the listing; the source does not say whether it runs to the cab floor. Do not confuse with the Eastern US Lookouts page easternuslookouts.weebly.com/maxton.html, which is a different Maxton (Chippewa County, Michigan). The NC page's entry is the one used.
